shared_elements: upright freestanding slab/pillar-like monolith with carving on its broad face
low-relief animal or creature shown against a plain surface
curvilinear relief motifs on a vertical field
justification: Both are upright slab monuments bearing shallow relief on the broad face, and each shows a quadruped-like creature in relief on an otherwise plain ground, but that is a generic correspondence. A depicts a single isolated animal in profile high on a bare pillar, while B depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a face, headdress-like striations, a large chest disc, a belt/waist band and a dense cluster of curvilinear ornaments — a wholly different iconographic scheme and much busier, symmetrical, body-centred composition.
